title: Indian, Pakistani Naval Vessels Collide in Arabian Sea, Prompting Diplomatic Tensions
author: Sudha Ramachandran
text:
Credit: ID 383015385 © Igor_Tichonow
On September 15, PNS Hunain, a Pakistan Navy corvette, collided with an Indian Navy warship, INS Kolkata, in the north Arabian Sea, 220 kilometers east of Oman. The following day, India’s Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) summoned Pakistan’s top-most diplomat in New Delhi, Chargé d’Affaires Saad Ahmad Warraich, to the foreign ministry to protest the “unacceptable and unprofessional conduct” of ​Pakistani naval units.“While the incident, which took place in international waters, did not cause any major damage, the conduct of the Pakistani naval ship was in direct contravention of Article 10 of the Agreement between India and Pakistan on Advance Notice on Military Exercises, Manoeuvres and Troops Movements of April 1991,” the MEA said in a statement.[...]
